marta-g: quick follow-up after the late-night auth/model-registry partial failures. want a compact action tracker that captures owners, coverage windows, and recurrence assessment.

vikram: yep — PM says the auth vendor spikes at irregular intervals but roughly every 2-3 days. treat as a recurring transient for now. we need short-term mitigations + medium term SLA asks.

joey: inventory of current controls i see: rollback script for bad model manifests (joey), short-lived token cache + jittered TTL (sylvia), failover routing rule (ops). missing: automated alert classification and a circuit breaker that prevents cascading model load retries.

sylvia: i'll own the cache smoothing + TTL jitter. plan: implement exponential backoff + healthcheck probe. ETA: end of week. adding a /health/auth-check endpoint.

incident-bot: Postmortem logged: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4531 )
